goal: Fix the two failures found in the first live run on 2026-10-06: decision fingerprints and Ledger row shapes broke because ChatGPT hand-built the Ledger readback differently between steps. Add one canonical readback command, a decide command and a pursuit-state command that use that one file, make package feed the pursuit gate from the same file, and make slate stamp First_Seen/Last_Verified.
acceptance_conditions: readback converts raw Sheets values (header row first) into the exact JOBS 20 / APPLICATIONS 10 / LOG 9 (and optional NETWORK 13) row objects: short rows padded with "", null cells become "", empty rows skipped; it fails closed on header mismatch, non-string cells, values beyond the last header, unknown or missing required tabs, and duplicate Job_IDs; its output passes run.load_ledger and the network loader.

decide builds the event only through pursuit_decision.build_decision_mutation_plan, fingerprints the JOBS row from the same ledger file, sets supersedes_event_id to the current latest event, refuses invalid decisions, offset-less timestamps and an unchanged repeat decision, and emits one Bora_Decision cell plus one exact 9-column LOG row.
pursuit-state reports state, authorizes_pursuit, latest_event_id and the context fingerprint from the same ledger file; STALE and non-PURSUE states never authorize.
package passes the live Ledger JOBS row and Ledger LOG rows to the pursuit gate (effective_request.json) after the existing identity checks.
slate requires --as-of with a UTC offset and writes it to First_Seen and Last_Verified of new JOBS rows.
pursuit_decision.py, the package gate and the cloud adapter are unchanged; the CLI stays local and writes nothing external.
Runbook and config document readback, decide, pursuit-state and slate --as-of; contract id is CAREER_OS_RUN_CONTRACT_V1_2.
review_requirements: STOP after one PR is opened. Do not merge until Bora obtains a fresh independent read-only SAFE review.
stop_conditions: Any need to change pursuit_decision.py, the package gate, resume QA, Candidate Truth, the renderer or the cloud adapter.
Any need to write Drive/Sheets from this engineering PR.
Any change that lets a stale, WATCH or REJECT decision authorize packaging.
human_approval_requirements: Bora retains merge authority, every PURSUE/WATCH/REJECT decision, all Ledger/Drive writes, and all submissions.
